# Delete each original request and create new one with corrected amount (original - 5)

    # Create new request with corrected amount

        user_email=req['receiver']['email'],
        amount=corrected_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=req['description'],
        private=req['private']
    )
    print(f"Created new request for {req['receiver']['email']} with amount {corrected_amount}: {create_result}")
